title: PBKDF2 加盐哈希与校验（固定盐/固定迭代，正反用例）
expected_output:
iterations=120000
derived_key_hex=fc751685d85e1a1b0bd3bfe66d90f181053171e1b44b214a95d2e03037494efd
derived_key_len=32
correct_password_ok=True
wrong_password_ok=False
same_password_diff_salt_same_hash=False

code:
# 密码存储：PBKDF2 加盐 + 迭代成本（bcrypt 非标准库，这里用 hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac 等价演示）
import hashlib, hmac

ITERATIONS = 120000
SALT_A = b'0123456789abcdef'
SALT_B = b'fedcba9876543210'


def hash_password(password: str, salt: bytes, iterations: int = ITERATIONS) -> bytes:
    return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac('sha256', password.encode('utf-8'), salt, iterations)


def verify_password(password: str, salt: bytes, expected: bytes,
                    iterations: int = ITERATIONS) -> bool:
    return hmac.compare_digest(hash_password(password, salt, iterations), expected)


stored = hash_password('correct horse battery staple', SALT_A)
print('iterations=' + str(ITERATIONS))
print('derived_key_hex=' + stored.hex())
print('derived_key_len=' + str(len(stored)))
print('correct_password_ok=' + str(verify_password('correct horse battery staple', SALT_A, stored)))
print('wrong_password_ok=' + str(verify_password('correct horse battery stapl3', SALT_A, stored)))

# 同一个密码 + 不同盐 -> 完全不同的哈希（防彩虹表 + 防"同密码撞库可见"）
other = hash_password('correct horse battery staple', SALT_B)
print('same_password_diff_salt_same_hash=' + str(stored == other))

# 迭代成本是可调的：单轮 SHA-256 与 PBKDF2 的差距就是"离线爆破慢多少"
single = hashlib.sha256(('0123456789abcdef' + 'correct horse battery staple').encode()).hexdigest()
print('single_sha256_hex=' + single)
print('single_sha256_differs=' + str(single != stored.hex()))
print('salt_not_baked_in_hash=' + str(b'0123456789abcdef' not in stored))
